Name: Grey's Basher
Description:
Manufacturer: Unknown
Focus: Interceptor
A testament to making something out of nothing, the Basher comes together to form a beast to be reckoned with. The long development of this ship, due to Greycat's trial-and-error approach to mixing ship parts until they figured out the best combinations, goes to show the work put in to elevate this machine from the scraps it was built from.
